prediction: With dynamic-linking enabled, the documented bootstrap route will get past the rustc_driver dylib crate-type rejection. If retained K1–K4 inputs satisfy the dynamic links, llvm-readelf and llvm-nm will expose rustc’s interpreter and its dependency on librustc_driver, plus relocations, TLS and undefined symbols for both ELFs. Budget 10800 seconds for the stage-1 build, with four jobs under taskpolicy.
